_comment: What bootstrap.py installs for this layer. brew: taps and formulas. steps: check (0 = already there) and run. expect: tested version; brew cannot install an old one, it only warns if it changed. logins and manual: final checklist, secrets are never stored.
logins: claude   (open Claude Code and log in)
gh auth login   (HTTPS; then gh auth setup-git so git uses that login: it works for cloning and pushing ai-setup)
ssh-keygen -t ed25519   and add the public key to your git remote
manual: Install Orca from its website, open it and check that ~/.agents/skills has orca-cli and orchestration
Reconnect the per-project MCP servers: claude mcp add … and /mcp (restart the session afterwards)
